title: Ramp live number
description: A mono figure that keeps counting up by small random steps, like a live usage counter; the digits that change roll up into place.
notes: needs JavaScript to tick; static HTML shows the starting value
with reduced motion it holds still
name: ramp-live-number

props.name: start
props.description: the value shown first (and in static HTML)

props.name: step
props.description: the largest step per tick; each tick adds a random amount up to this
